description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various categories across a dataset, with each slice representing a distinct topic and its corresponding percentage of the total. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to "AI/NLP Research" and accounts for 24.3% of the total, making it the most prevalent category. The second-largest segment, in teal, represents "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%. Other notable categories include "History" and "Game&Anime," both at 8.2%, and "Med & Health" and "Science," each at 6.7%. Smaller segments include "Daily Life" (7.1%), "Pet & Animal" (5.5%), "Law" (5.1%), "Business" (5.9%), "Geography" (2.7%), "Math" (1.2%), and "Game&Anime" (8.2%). The chart uses distinct colors for each category and includes labels with percentages, with lines connecting the labels to their respective slices. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with the largest slices positioned at the top right and smaller slices distributed around the chart.
